comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As it is part of a quest chain, this quest cannot, to the best of my knowledge, be repeated after its completion... unless you lose the discovery card. As there is no ornament for Troy, the only other way to lose the card is through an official debate tournament (put it in your deck, and hope you lose), or, and this is the easier way, do a Treasure Hunt theme.

When Treasure Hunting, Discovery cards can be used when you are combining clues; when Troy's card appears, select it, and hope it's lost when successfully combining clue pieces. The higher the clue, IE, closer it is to Relic discovery, the more likely it is to consume the Discovery card from synthesis. Note that the pool of cards is randomly chosen and changes at various times (every hour on the hour, according to my testing), so don't expect it to happen right away. Every TH theme has different cards available at any given time, too, so if Troy isn't showing up for you while running Hidden Hero theme, switching to another theme could cause it to show up there. Not that this is exactly easy to do, of course... clues don't exactly grow on trees.

An anonymous player noted further: "Another way to loose the card is to present it to the city official in your colonial capital, or in Lima, in Ambon or in Ternate. But that is also iffy. You usually may get a limited selection of cards you may present, they change every day in a seemingly random way and there's no guarantee the one you want to get rid of will appear on the list soon, or ever. Loosing it through the treasure hunt clue combining process appears easier, at least the random list is longer and you don't need to travel in order to check :-)."

I went out of my way to lose the Troy card, as did some friends, and we've never regained it to be able to help others pull this quest when needed. Strangely, after losing the card, I could swear I've seen this quest pop up sometimes despite being fleeted with someone who's previously discovered it. Maybe I'm recalling incorrectly, though.

comments.author: Scrimshaw
comments.body:
Thanks guys for the quick replies. I was already off to the races before I actually got to read your responses but I will recount my experience since my last post...

My adventure toon Scrimshaw had already done this chain, acquired the Archaeologist job, and never lost any of the discovery cards. I was trying to use his skill ranks to repeat this chain for my battle toon EL_NINO who met no requirements beyond the 1st quest. Nino pulled the 1st quest fleeted with Scrimshaw who then accepted and both did quest.

Getting to "Troy" I tried pulling it with Scrimshaw as Nino had no requirement met. 30+ QMPs, some port hopping and doing other quests and no luck. Finally I broke down and used an SQMP with NINO and it showed up on the 1st try despite missing all reqs by a long shot. My 2 idiots were fleeted when this happened. Scrimshaw appointed Nino admiral and was able to also accept the quest for his 2nd time.

By "Treasure of the Kings of Troy" I was out of QMPs, so resorted to port hopping between Athens and Alexandria, as it can show up at either place. After over an hour of this with no luck I broke down and used another SQMP with El Nino and got it on the 1st try. Once again despite being way short on the skill requirements. And still fleeted with Scrimshaw who had done the whole chain before. Once Nino accepted he was made admiral again and Scrimshaw was able to accept it also. The dream team then proceeded to complete the quest.

Now since Scrimshaw was able to do the whole chain a 2nd time does that mean he would have been able to actually pull the quests himself a 2nd time given enough time, luck, and QMPs? Does using SQMPs bend the normal rules? I really don't know but I can confirm it is repeatable at least if someone else pulls it, and the person pulling it can be fleeted with someone who already did it at least if using SQMPs if that makes a difference. I will add that in the same situation recently with "Legend of the Labyrinthos" I was informed about having the ornament made to get rid of the discovery card, which I then did (after failing numerous times to pull the quest), and it popped after only 2 or 3 QMPs.

Sorry for the crazy long post but realizing how frustrating (and expensive) it can get sometimes trying to pull certain quests I thought this info may help.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Glad it worked out for you. I wish I knew if SQMPs broke the standard quest chain rule, or if the rule's even been relaxed in the case of some quests, but I'm afraid only the developers probably know that for sure.

As you've seen though, it is possible to repeat any quest in the game (assuming you've met pre-discovery/port permit requirements, if any exist), even quests that are part of a chain, as long as:

1. Someone else has pulled them, and is Admiral of your fleet
2. You have not just finished the quest

By #2, I mean if you just finished the "Treasures of the Kings of Troy" and reported it in Athens, then somebody in Athens (or anywhere else that quest spawns) tried to fleet with you as admiral and share the "Treasures of the Kings of Troy" quest with you, the game would not let you accept it until you reported another quest as complete.

Of course, if you'd reported first "Kings of Troy" and then a second quest complete immediately after it by using cultural contribution to run two quests at a time, you'd be set to do "Kings of Troy" again right away. It'd be the -other- quest you couldn't do again, until you reported something else in its place.

And no worries on the post. The DB is for sharing gameplay tips/insights, right? Cheers, and great online voyaging to you.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
One possible problem is that Marseille is a capital city. It has a lot of possible quests to generate and setting the regional search doesn't guarantee any fewer wrong quests will appear.

I believe this quest is also considered to be "rare", meaning its appearance is a low probability. As long as it was not the last quest you did on your main (you cannot run the same quest twice in a row), it should appear again eventually. Having the listed skill ranks (boost equipment is okay) may increase its likelihood of appearing.

Lastly, using a Letter of Appreciation from Seafarers item and selecting Job Endorsement can let you obtain the job card from a specific NPC without running the quest, if that is your goal. You can check job pages or cards to see if there's a list in that case.
